facts.text: The C++ node creates a std_msgs::msg::String publisher on the absolute /pick_place_status topic with queue size 10.
The C++ node creates a std_msgs::msg::Float64 publisher on /gripper_joint/command with queue size 10.
The C++ node subscribes to /target_point with std_msgs::msg::Float64MultiArray and rejects a message with fewer than four numbers.
The /target_point callback reads data[0], data[1], data[2] and data[3] as x, y, yaw and box and marks a new target available when any value differs from the last accepted value or the box changes.
The target callback updates target_x, target_y, target_yaw, target_box and new_target_available under a mutex.
The main loop takes the pending target under the mutex, clears new_target_available and calls executePickAndPlace; a target received during the sequence is only queued for the next loop iteration.

executePickAndPlace publishes ACTIVE, opens the gripper, moves in XY, rotates yaw, moves down 0.255 m, closes the gripper, moves up 0.255 m, moves to the box, moves down 0.255 m, opens, moves up 0.255 m and moves to the arm_ready named pose, sleeping between the steps.
When executePickAndPlace fails, the main loop logs the failure, publishes ERROR, breaks out of the loop, cancels the executor, joins the spinner thread and calls rclcpp::shutdown().
The node initialises target_box to -1.0 and last_x, last_y and last_yaw to 0.0.
The main loop declares a local delay of 2 seconds.
For box 1 the node assigns x 0.4 and y -0.53; for box 2 it assigns x 0.4 and y 0.53; there is no other branch and box_x and box_y are otherwise uninitialized.
moveToWorldXY calls move_group.execute(trajectory) and returns true without checking the execute result.
rotateGripperYaw calls move_group.execute(trajectory) and returns true without checking the execute result.
moveDownZ calls move_group.execute(trajectory) and returns true without checking the execute result.
moveUpZ calls move_group.execute(trajectory) and returns true without checking the execute result.
moveToNamedPose calls move_group.execute(plan), then reads the current pose and returns true without checking the execute result.
closeGripper calls gripper_group.execute(plan) and returns true without checking the execute result.
openGripper calls gripper_group.execute(plan) and returns true without checking the execute result.
The status timer publishes current_status every 200 ms.
The node declares MoveGroupInterface planning groups arm and gripper and a node named ur5_xy_yaw_approach.
The node declares pos_tol 0.001 and yaw_tol 0.01 as configurable ROS parameters with those defaults.
The node uses a SingleThreadedExecutor on a spinner thread and a separate main loop for the motion sequence.
The only cancel call in the C++ node is executor.cancel() after the main loop, followed by spinner.join() and rclcpp::shutdown().
The target publisher creates a Float64MultiArray publisher on /target_point with queue size 10 and a String subscription on /target_class_cmd.
The target publisher writes [x, y, yaw, box] into Float64MultiArray.data and uses -1.0 when no box is set.
The target publisher publishes only when a detection's class_name equals the requested target class and then sets published true.
CMake builds the ur5_pick_place_cpp_r executable.
CMake also builds a second executable, ur5_pick_place_cpp_s, from src/ur5_pick_place_cpp_s.cpp.
ur5_pick_place_cpp_s subscribes to /target_point with std_msgs::msg::Float64MultiArray.
CMake installs ur5_pick_place_cpp_r under lib/ur5_moveit_config.
The README runs ros2 run ur5_moveit_config ur5_pick_place_cpp_r after the MoveIt demo launch.
moveit_controllers.yaml declares arm_controller type FollowJointTrajectory with action_ns follow_joint_trajectory and gripper_controller type GripperCommand with action_ns gripper_cmd.
ros2_controllers.yaml declares arm_controller as joint_trajectory_controller/JointTrajectoryController and gripper_controller as position_controllers/GripperActionController.

determinism.notes: Event-driven rosbridge fake with canned status and a target echo; no physics step, motion planning, trajectory execution or wall-clock pacing

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS publication/subscription fake (no Isaac Sim, MoveIt or physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free analytic contract stand-in, not a recording of captured traffic: it runs no Isaac Sim scene, no MoveIt move_group, no controller, no YOLOv8 detector and no ROS graph

the /target_point publication is transmission-only; the fake's ACTIVE status and the resource target_point are placeholder echoes of the last command on the shared topic, not proof that the C++ node accepted, planned or moved
the /pick_place_status values are placeholders; the real node republishes current_status every 200 ms (ur5_pick_place_cpp_r.cpp:395-399)

the upstream pick-and-place sequence is open loop: it sleeps between blocking move_group.execute calls, ignores their return values (lines 81-82, 125-126, 159-160, 215-216) and has no stop or cancel service or action

/target_point is a command topic that only clients publish (the chatbot target publisher once per requested target, target_publisher.py:79-124); the fake answers its subscription at once, but in a real graph each target publication waits about 2 s for the receipt's resource snapshot and mhs.resource.read fails NOT_READY (probe with the topic silent)

after any failed step the node publishes ERROR once, leaves its main loop and shuts down (ur5_pick_place_cpp_r.cpp:480-497); /pick_place_status is silent afterwards and every status read fails NOT_READY

the upstream chatbot path publishes box -1.0 when no box is named (target_publisher.py:109-117), which leaves box_x and box_y uninitialised before the place move (lines 319-330); this package refuses any box other than 1 or 2, but another client on /target_point can still send -1

the clone also builds and installs ur5_pick_place_cpp_s, a variant on the same /target_point that publishes no /pick_place_status and moves 0.233 m in z (ur5_pick_place_cpp_s.cpp:287, 293, 359-362); if an operator runs it, every status read fails NOT_READY

NOT COVERED: /Yolov8_Inference, /rgb, /inference_result, /inference_result_cv2, /target_class_cmd, the MoveIt move_group and controller actions, the gripper, Isaac Sim physics, collision checking, the physical UR5 and the target publisher's camera calibration

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop is exposed by the pinned clone: the node only consumes /target_point and runs a blocking, open-loop MoveIt sequence; the software latch refuses later publications but does not stop the active sequence or the external MoveIt controller, so no safe state is claimed.
